description: Golden J — 60-year projection from Golden B 2028 end-state; indicator history, payback year, and labor utilization arcs

_meta.note: Projections are conditional forecasts under "no further decisions," not predictions. The delta shows marginal impact of current action set vs. autonomous dynamics.

assertions.laramie_payback_year_note: Property-tax-based payback for dual-SMR (2 x 345 MW) investment in Laramie County. Nuclear capital intensity means payback_year > 2070 for Wyoming mill-levy rates. Range of +/-3 years accounts for minor floating-point differences across runtimes.
assertions.campbell_service_funding_note: school_finance_net is negative for Campbell (mineral recapture county). service_funding_per_capita is negative and becomes less negative as coal production declines — the recapture burden shrinks. Absolute value decreases 2028-2038.
